text:
mira: quick pitch  propose a small console IA experiment: reorganize the left nav into three persistent zones (Workspaces | Model registry | Insights) and tighten our deep-link contract. Goal: fewer mental hops for new users, reliable external deep-links, and predictable keyboard navigation. Sketch + contract below.

mira: Canonical URL examples we want to guarantee: 
```
/app/w/:wsId
/app/w/:wsId/registry/:modelId
/app/w/:wsId/registry/:modelId/config
/app/w/:wsId/insights/requests?range=30d
```

mira: Design Qs: 
- Visual breadcrumbs: fully explicit (Workspace > Registry > Model) or minimal (Workspace > Model)?
- Routing: enforce pathname-only routes or continue supporting hashes for some panes?
- Migration: how do we handle existing bookmarked `/#/` URLs?

jon: eng view: pathname-only. Hashes break native back/forward semantics and make copy/paste fragile. We'll migrate to react-router path routes.

priya: PM: +1 for pathnames. Also want a migration plan for high-value bookmarks and integrations. Can we detect common legacy patterns and redirect?

mira: plan: server-side rewrite rules for `^/#/ws/(.*)` -> `/app/w/$1` for 6 months, plus a client replaceState() shim on mount to honor deep-links without polluting history. Banner in console to notify users.

sam: accessibility notes: 
- Make each zone a distinct nav landmark (role="navigation" aria-label). 
- Provide a keyboard skipbar: "Skip to Workspaces | Skip to Registry | Skip to Insights" as first focusable elements. 
- Breadcrumbs should mark the last item with aria-current="page". 
- If we move the active item because of the regroup, announce via aria-live polite: "Navigation updated: Models active".

lee: UX nit: prefer minimal visual breadcrumbs (WorkspaceName > ModelName). Avoid repeating nouns like "Registry" in the UI, but keep the full path in the URL for debuggability. Also prefer chevron separators and middle-ellipsis truncation on narrow widths.

jon: impl sketch:
```
<Routes>
  <Route path="/app/w/:wsId" element={<WorkspaceShell />}>
    <Route path="registry/:modelId" element={<ModelDetail />} />
    <Route path="insights/:panel" element={<InsightsPanel />} />
  </Route>
</Routes>
```
Migration shim: if location.hash matches `#/...` then compute new pathname and do history.replaceState(null, '', newPath) before app mount completes. Also add server redirects for direct hits.

priya: rollout idea: feature-flag by workspace. Canary 5% of orgs, monitor these metrics: deep-link resolution rate, time-to-first-action, sidebar search frequency, and bookmark bounce rate. Rollback threshold: 12% degradation on a critical metric.

arya-bot: reminder: log old->new redirect mappings for analytics. Capture top 100 legacy URLs by hits and verify redirects succeed.

sam: keyboard specifics: Up/Down to move in a list, Left/Right to jump zone headers, Home/End to go first/last in a zone, Enter/Space to open. Ensure separators are focusable so screen-reader users can skip zones quickly. Focus ring: 2px high-contrast outline per tokens.

mira: copy tweak: change sidebar label from "Models & Assets" to "Model registry". Keep "Assets" surfaced in a secondary inline label or tooltip.

lee: small accessibility UX: when breadcrumb truncates, show tooltip with full path on hover/focus. Also announce "breadcrumb truncated" via polite live region only when truncation changes due to resize.

jon: tests: will add unit tests for route matching and e2e for keyboard focus flow + redirect shim. Also add integration tests asserting that legacy hash -> pathname redirects don't push extra history entries.

priya: comms: I'll draft a migration email template and a docs page with a redirect table and FAQs. Solutions team to email top customers after banner is live.

mira: action items:
- mira: finalize mocks + breadcrumb truncation spec (by Wed)
- jon: prototype react-router migration + client shim (start tomorrow)
- sam: formal a11y checklist + keyboard test scripts (by next Tue)
- priya: migration docs + customer comms draft (by Mon)
- arya-bot: collect top legacy URLs for analytics (today)

jon: I'll open the RFC PR and post a staging preview.

mira: thanks all. consensus on pathname-first routing, condensed breadcrumb visuals, a11y landmarks & skiplinks, server+client shim for legacy hashes. PR ownership to @jon.

lee: :thumbsup:

priya: will schedule a short support training once staging preview is available.

mira: closing thread  follow-up in Fri design review if anything blocks.
